long_biography.plain_text:
Frank Rodriguez entered automotive retail as a Florida showroom salesman in 1979. He advanced to general-management roles at Honda and Ford dealerships, then became an owner in 1995 when he bought into the Orlando business that became Greenway Ford. He later acquired the remaining interest and added further franchises.

With business partner Carl Atkinson, Rodriguez developed Greenway Automotive into a multi-brand dealership group operating across several US states. The partners also pursued an early expansion into China. Rodriguez remains a Greenway principal and corporate officer. The group combines central ownership with local operating partners across its network.
